notes: This paper is a factorial design with two factors: humic acid foliar application (HFA) at 3 doses (0.33, 0.67, 1.0 L/ha or similar) and biofertilizer NPK (B0=control, B1=mineral NPK, B2=bio-NPK), conducted over 2 seasons (2016-17 and 2017-18) on oat (Avena sativa) in Iraq. The GT rows (pairs 241-246) represent the HFA dose-response arms for grain yield at two season ctrl baselines (0.3117 and 0.2459 ton/ha). The JSON extractor captured grain yield only for the B2 biofertilizer arm (ctrl=2.739 and 3.889 ton/ha, effect ~190-197%), which is a different treatment arm with much higher absolute values and different effect sizes. The HFA dose-response grain yield was not captured in the JSON obs. All 6 GT rows are unmatched due to coverage failure — the extractor missed the HFA dose-response yield table and focused on growth analysis variables (FLA, LAD, LAI, CGR, NAR, RGR) plus only the B2 biofertilizer yield arm.
